blocks.text: Chiclayo, Peru—A luckless Peruvian town that has for centuries been dismissed as cursed is hoping for a new lease on life when Pope Leo visits this month. Under Spanish colonial rule in the 16th century, Zana — home to around 4,000 souls — was a wealthy center of commerce dotted with grandiose churches. But three centuries after it was nearly destroyed by a flood of biblical proportions, vultures now roost in its ruined steeples.
